name: Danya Cebus Ltd.
summary: Danya Cebus Ltd. operates as a construction and infrastructure company in Israel and internationally. It undertakes infrastructure projects, including road paving, building railway infrastructure, construction of bridges, parking lots, tunnel mining, and associated infrastructure development, as well as commercial, industrial, and residential infrastructures.
